title:
Less ticket bouncing.
A clearer path to resolution.
narration: Stop sending one problem on a tour of support queues.

title: Report it once.
label: EMPLOYEE PORTAL
detail: Describe the issue. Track the request.
narration: Maya, a sales employee, reports her blocked dashboard once.

title: TicketPilot classifies it.
label: AUTOMATIC CLASSIFICATION
detail: The team is identified from past resolutions.
narration: TicketPilot classifies the issue: Applications. Daniel, the support engineer, approves the route.

title: See the evidence.
label: MATCHING CASE
detail: See who resolved it and what worked.
narration: He opens a matching case and checks what worked before.

title: Bring the fix along.
label: SUGGESTED FIX + SOURCE
narration: TicketPilot suggests a fix with a source. Daniel reviews it and records the work.

title: Confirm the outcome.
label: BACK WITH MAYA
detail: Still broken? Ask for more help.
takeaway: Close the loop with the employee.
narration: Maya gets an update and confirms her dashboard works.

title: See service health.
label: LEADER VIEW
detail: Sample dashboard. Validate impact in a pilot.
narration: Elena, the IT service manager, reviews outcomes and handoffs.

title: Try TicketPilot.
narration: Try TicketPilot. Follow a request in the guided demo.
